sentences.text: Our array has 8 positions, indexed 0 through 7.
Start at index 0, its value is 3.
3 belongs at index 2, which currently contains minus 1.
3 is now at index 2, and minus 1 arrives at index 0.
So stop there, move to index 1, its value is 4.
4 reaches index 3, and now index 1 holds 1.
Stay at index 1, because the arriving one also needs a home.
1 belongs at index 0, which holds minus 1.
Index 2 contains 3, already in its home.
Index 3 contains 4, already in its home.
Index 4 contains 1, its home is index 0.
This is a duplicate, so do not swap.
2 belongs at index 1, which currently holds minus 1.
2 reaches index 1, and minus 1 arrives at index 7.
Now scan from left to right, checking each expected value.
So 5 is the first missing positive.
